subject: max instances on each account type

messages.author: f957fda17cafa763
messages.subject: max instances on each account type
parts:
Hello,
I have the Basic plan, I've read the relevant support articles on shinyapps, but am having difficulty finding an answer to this question:
- what are the maximum number of instances I can have per application?
I know it's 1 for the free plan, and I know it's multiple instances as part of the 'performance boost' for Basic, but can anyone put a number to this?
thanks in advance, Andrew

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: max instances on each account type
parts:
In the case of Basic it is 3.

http://docs.rstudio.com/shinyapps.io/applications.html#ApplicationInstances

messages.subject: Re: max instances on each account type
parts:
Thank you for your help Joshua.

I'm not sure I completely understand how tuning works.

I have a survey app and the basic plan: my settings are 3 instances, 1 worker per instance, and 1 connection per worker.

I've found that if I have multiple connections or multiple workers per instance, then user sessions interfere with each other and I do not receive a pure survey response from a single user (* if this seems strange to you -- it does to me -- then I may have been doing something wrong)

Therefore I reduced the settings to a single connection per instance (and restarted). But now if I try to run 2 sessions of my app (using 2 computers) I find that 1 works, but 1 shows a "capacity reached" error. It doesn't switch to a different instance, whereas I would expect to be able to run 3 sessions at once. (I'm sure there are no other users, as this happens just after restart)

Can anyone think what the problem is, or what I'm doing wrong?

cheers, Andrew

messages.subject: Re: max instances on each account type
parts:
Yes, we need to revamp some of the tuning documentation to be more clear about that.
"start count" is how many of the previously created instances to start when resuming the application from sleeping.
